query:
SELECT artist AS "artist!", id AS "id!"
                FROM (
                    SELECT at.artist, g.id,
                           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY at.artist ORDER BY g.id) AS rn
                    FROM artist_tag at
                    JOIN tag t ON t.id = at.tag
                    JOIN genre g ON g.name = t.name
                    WHERE at.artist = ANY($1)
                      AND ($2::int IS NULL OR g.id > $2)
                ) ranked
                WHERE rn <= $3
                ORDER BY artist, id
